query_name: Sub-Category Return Rate, Profit Margin and Sales
sql_query:
SELECT o.sub_category AS SUB_CATEGORY,
       COALESCE(CAST(r.return_orders AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(o.total_orders,0),0) AS "Return Rate %",
       (o.sum_profit / NULLIF(o.sum_sales,0)) AS "Profit Margin",
       o.sum_sales AS "Total Sales"
FROM (
  SELECT sub_category,
         COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders,
         SUM(sales) AS sum_sales,
         SUM(profit) AS sum_profit
  FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders
  WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS}
  GROUP BY sub_category
) o
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT o2.sub_category, COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS return_orders
  FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_returns r
  JOIN tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o2
    ON r.order_id = o2.order_id
  WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS}
  GROUP BY o2.sub_category
) r
  ON o.sub_category = r.sub_category
ORDER BY o.sum_sales DESC;
description: Per sub-category metrics: return rate (distinct returned orders / distinct orders), profit margin (profit/sales), and total sales. All subqueries include {SLICER_CONDITIONS}.

sql_query:
SELECT o.region AS REGION,
       SUM(o.sales) AS "Total Sales",
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS "Total Orders",
       COALESCE(CAST(r.return_orders AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),0),0) AS "Return Rate %"
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT o2.region, COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS return_orders
  FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_returns r
  JOIN tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o2
    ON r.order_id = o2.order_id
  WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS}
  GROUP BY o2.region
) r
  ON o.region = r.region
WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS}
GROUP BY o.region
ORDER BY "Total Sales" DESC;
description: Region-level totals: sales, distinct orders, and return rate. Both main and returns subquery apply {SLICER_CONDITIONS}.

query_name: Total Sales by Year and SEGMENT
sql_query:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS Year,
       SUM(CASE WHEN segment = 'Consumer' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS "Consumer",
       SUM(CASE WHEN segment = 'Corporate' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS "Corporate",
       SUM(CASE WHEN segment = 'Home Office' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS "Home Office"
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders
WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS}
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)
ORDER BY Year;
description: Yearly total sales pivoted into three segment columns (Consumer, Corporate, Home Office). Uses {SLICER_CONDITIONS}.
